pair_attestations.reason: Updated Process_FeatureStaging to model the agent-built preview defer-and-verify loop (#2881, PR #2885): GW_AgentBuilt checks branches/<slug>/_build-record.json against MERGE_SHA^{tree}, Task_Defer marks preview/agent-build pending and queues preview-verify-sweep.yml off the critical path, and GW_VerifyMatch skips deploy/render-log when the full CI rebuild matches the agent record or replaces branches/<slug>/ on mismatch.
